title: Notice and action
description: For a service that hosts or shares user content: reporting, reasoned decisions, appeals and the records transparency reports need.

sources.title: Regulation (EU) 2021/784 on addressing the dissemination of terrorist content online
The Santa Clara Principles on Transparency and Accountability in Content Moderation

rules.instruction: Let anyone report content they consider illegal or against the rules, with the location of the content, a reason and an optional contact.
rules.verification: Open the reporting flow and check that it captures the location, the reason and a contact, and that reports reach a review queue.

rules.instruction: When content is removed or restricted or an account is suspended, tell the affected user the facts, the rule applied, whether the decision was automated and how to contest it.
rules.verification: Read the statement of reasons template and a sent example and check the four elements.

rules.instruction: Let affected users contest a decision and have the appeal reviewed by a person who did not take the first decision.
rules.verification: Check the appeal flow and that appeal records name a reviewer different from the first decision maker.

rules.instruction: Name the contact point and the on-call owner who can act on a removal order for terrorist content within one hour of receipt.
rules.verification: Check the published contact point and the on-call schedule for removal orders.

rules.instruction: Record notices, decisions, automated actions, appeals and response times in a form that can be counted for transparency reports.
rules.verification: Run the report query for the last period and check that each category returns a count.
